description: Single normative authorization contract. Trusted runtime identity and coordinator-asserted application identity are separate, token-bound facts; caller-supplied identity is never trusted. Metadata, content and control are independent gates. Unproven authorization fails closed.

trustedRuntime.note: Supplied by the Copilot host to the extension process (SESSION_ID / joinSession / hooks). Never accepted from a tool argument or an HTTP body.

assertedApplication.note: Asserted by the orchestrator when it dispatches a child. Becomes usable only after it is bound to a trusted runtime identity by redeeming a one-use enrollment token.

binding.note: Caller identity claims are ignored. A child may only ever describe the node/attempt its redeemed token bound it to.

gates.metadata: Identity, topology, state, health, timing and counters.
gates.content: Free text: prompts, plans, progress, details, error text, message bodies, artifacts.
gates.control: Anything that changes run topology, grants delivery, or sets terminal status.

orchestrator.establishedBy: run.declared written by this runtime identity, or an orchestrator grant bound to it

child.establishedBy: redeeming a one-use enrollment token issued by the orchestrator

system.establishedBy: the extension's own watchdog and reconciler inside a process already enrolled in the run

viewer.establishedBy: a short-TTL loopback instance credential exchanged from a one-use bootstrap
viewer.note: The canvas may read the projection and queue an explicitly targeted user message. Queuing a message is not a control grant.

incidentsGrantNothing.note: Incident and message content is data only. It can never move an approval gate, mint delivery authority, authorize a push, or set a terminal state.

hostActivityIsNotOutcome.note: Idle, end-of-turn, session end and heartbeat loss are host activity or health only.
